conditions.description: One run of usp_run_payment_segments, from empty bronze, silver and gold targets, takes the synthetic sources all the way to the new columns of silv_membership_events. One run is enough only if the loads run in dependency order (bronze, lists, dimensions, attributes, event amounts, anomalies, silver event columns, gold fact columns).
conditions.preconditions: assumes (question to the human deferred 2026-11-12): usp_run_payment_segments takes @run_id uniqueidentifier = NULL and @as_of_date date = NULL, passes both on (as_of_date to the attributes load), logs its own etl_run_log row (layer 'run', step 'usp_run_payment_segments') and on a failing step stops and re-raises the error. Standard SetUp (all tests): every table the run's loads read or write is faked; seeds: payment methods 0/-1/-2, 1 DD, 2 Card, 3 Bank, 4 Cheque, 5 Corporate; payer types 0/-1/-2, 1 Individual, 2 Corporate; concession types 0/-1/-2 and 1 No concession; Campaign Years 2023-2025. Sources: Subs.tblSubsInvoices 1001 C1 CY2024 DD 450, 1002 C1 CY2025 Card 475, 2001 C2 CY2025 Corporate 300, 3001 C5 CY2025 Corporate 520, 4001 C6 CY2025 DD 410 (all GBP, not credited); CUSTTRANS_RICS one SUB line per invoice of C1, C2, C5 (MRICS, FRICS) and one line V9999 for C9 not in scope; vwCorpSubscriptions C2 S-100 CY2025 Active/Active; vwConcessionType 'Retired', 100% discount, perpetual, product rcsCONRETIRED. Phase 1 state: brnz_subs_status C1 2024 450.000000, C1 2025 475.000000, C2 2025 300.000000, C5 2025 520.000000 (all 'Fully Paid'); silv_payment_events C1 2024, C1 2025, C2 2025, C5 2025; events 101 RN:C1:2024, 102 RN:C1:2025, 201 RN:C2:2025, 301 JR:C3 (Join CY2025, no paid position, no invoice), 401 LA:C4 (Lapse CY2025), 501 RN:C5:2025, each with new columns at 0 / NULL; fact rows for the same events; one Phase 1 anomaly NO_ELECTION_DATE:C4. Run with @as_of_date 2025-06-15 (current Campaign Year 2025).
conditions.expected: silv_membership_events (event_id, payment method, carried, payer type, carried, concession, carried, subs_amount_gbp, invoiced_subtotal_gbp, amount_status): 101 (1,0,1,0,1,0,450.0000,450.0000,'Invoiced'); 102 (2,0,1,0,1,0,475.0000,475.0000,'Invoiced'); 201 (5,0,2,0,1,0,300.0000,300.0000,'Invoiced'); 301 (0,0,0,0,0,0,NULL,NULL,'No invoice'); 401 (0,0,0,0,0,0,NULL,NULL,NULL); 501 (5,0,1,0,1,0,520.0000,520.0000,'Invoiced').
